# Hanzo Works

> The apps a company runs on — sales, marketing, support, books, cap table,
> incorporation, workflows — served as capabilities on one API. Every claim on
> this site maps to a real address under `https://api.hanzo.ai/v1/`. One API,
> one identity, one balance.

Hanzo Works is the business face of the Hanzo cloud. It is not a suite of
separate products with separate logins: each capability below is a route family
on the same binary, scoped to your org by the same IAM token, metered against
the same balance. An agent can call every one of them with the credential it
already holds.

Identity is Hanzo IAM at `https://hanzo.id` — OIDC, Authorization Code + PKCE.
There is no second login and no API key in a dotfile.

## Work

- [todo](https://api.hanzo.ai/v1/todo): Boards, the work items on them, and the filters that make a board. An agent claims an issue at `POST /v1/todo/projects/{key}/issues/{num}/claim`.
- [tasks](https://api.hanzo.ai/v1/tasks): Durable workflows that survive a crash, with every run visible and replayable.
- [auto](https://api.hanzo.ai/v1/auto): Workflows that run themselves, on a schedule or a webhook. Flows, runs, connectors, inbound hooks.
- [flow](https://api.hanzo.ai/v1/flow): Build an agent workflow on a visual canvas, run it, and read every run.
- [team](https://api.hanzo.ai/v1/team): Your org's shared workspace — documents edited together, files, seats, and agents as teammates.

## Customers

- [crm](https://api.hanzo.ai/v1/crm): Your sales pipeline — the companies, the people, the deals in play.
- [campaigns](https://api.hanzo.ai/v1/campaigns): One go-to-market push across paid, organic and email at once.
- [marketing](https://api.hanzo.ai/v1/marketing): Lifecycle email — drip sequences that reach the right people. Audiences, calendar, promos, suppressions.
- [ads](https://api.hanzo.ai/v1/ads): Your paid ad campaigns, launched and paused from one place.
- [content](https://api.hanzo.ai/v1/content): Marketing content from draft to published, on every channel.
- [help](https://api.hanzo.ai/v1/help): A support desk — customers file tickets, your team answers them.
- [channels](https://api.hanzo.ai/v1/channels): One inbox for the chat apps you connect — Discord, Slack, Teams, Telegram.
- [notify](https://api.hanzo.ai/v1/notify): Transactional email and SMS, sent through your org's own provider credential.
- [affiliates](https://api.hanzo.ai/v1/affiliates): A partner program that pays commission on what your referrals spend.
- [referrals](https://api.hanzo.ai/v1/referrals): Referral attribution — who referred whom, and whether that referee became a real customer.

## The company itself

- [company](https://api.hanzo.ai/v1/company): Incorporation end to end — pick a structure, add founders, pay, file, and e-sign.
- [captable](https://api.hanzo.ai/v1/captable): Your cap table — stakeholders, share classes, grants, SAFEs, rounds, and who owns what.
- [books](https://api.hanzo.ai/v1/books): Double-entry accounting — chart of accounts, ledger, bank reconciliation, and the reports that prove the books balance.
- [esign](https://api.hanzo.ai/v1/esign): A document out for signature, signed and filed with an audit trail.
- [dataroom](https://api.hanzo.ai/v1/dataroom): A secure document room you share by link and watch page by page.

## Ship

- [projects](https://api.hanzo.ai/v1/projects): Where your sites live — create one, deploy a build, roll back to any release.
- [guide](https://api.hanzo.ai/v1/guide): A step-by-step checklist that gets your business running on AI.

## Reading the API yourself

- [The API index](https://api.hanzo.ai/v1): Every capability, with the address to follow. `GET /v1/<capability>` lists that capability's operations.
- [The OpenAPI document](https://api.hanzo.ai/v1/openapi.json): The whole served surface, generated from the live router — not hand-written, so it cannot describe a route that does not exist.
- [Health](https://api.hanzo.ai/v1/health): The running revision.

## The deep corpus

- [Hanzo Skills](https://hanzoskills.com/llms.txt): The full agent-facing index — hundreds of markdown documents covering every Hanzo standard (HIPs), SDK and capability. Start there for depth.
- [Agent onboarding manifest](https://hanzoskills.com/skill.md): How an agent installs, authenticates with a human operator, and works the cloud without doing damage. Read it before running anything.
- [Hanzo](https://hanzo.ai): The platform.

## Notes for models

- The prefix is `/v1` and there is no second version. There is no `/api/` segment anywhere.
- Collections are plural (`campaigns`, `projects`, `datasets`). A name stays singular only where there is no by-id member (`framework`, `reference`, `sync`).
- A capability answers at its own name: the first path segment after `/v1/` is the product.
- Do not invent an endpoint. If it is not in the OpenAPI document above, it is not served.
